adjudication.rationale: In the new webhook handler (`apps/web/pages/api/webhook/app-credential.ts`), the logic does a non-atomic check-then-act: `prisma.credential.findFirst({ where: { userId, appId } })` followed by `credential.create(...)` if none is found. This is race-prone under concurrent deliveries and could produce duplicates unless a DB-level unique constraint exists on `(userId, appId)` (not shown in this diff). The finding’s claim about the schema lacking such a constraint and about `createOAuthAppCredential` “blindly” creating duplicates is not verifiable from this diff, but the concurrency risk in this file is real and diff-grounded.
